sequence_nll.native_v3: Grammar-masked 0.05-smoothed per-program token cross entropy, then normalized program weights 0.05+percentile^4; sampled minibatch values in old endpoints.
sequence_nll.unit: nats; lower desired within fixed identity

ranking_bt.native_v3: Weighted softplus of loser reward minus winner reward for finite unequal-score within-comparison pairs; averaged reward heads and top-decile pair boost.

ranking_listwise.native_v3: Cross entropy from softmax(percentile/0.25) target to predicted log_softmax reward; nonzero target-entropy floor.
ranking_listwise.unit: nats; lower desired with same comparison groups

runtime_huber.native_v3: Smooth-L1/Huber on log1p predicted seconds against log1p recorded seconds.

contextfree_bt.native_v3: Program-only ablation ranking loss, coefficient0.05. Absent from Sep11 endpoint telemetry; present in60100 original logs.

val_seq_nll.policy_v3.2: Separate validation evaluator sets smoothing0.0 and averages batch NLL; distinct from val_loss_components.seq_nll (smoothed/provenance-weighted component).

val_pairwise_win_accuracy.policy_v3.2: Fraction of unequal-value within-dataset pairs whose predicted ordering Boolean agrees with target ordering. Predicted ties receive implementation-order-dependent Boolean treatment, not explicit half-credit.

val_ablation_pairwise_win.policy_v3.2: Same pairwise metric using genome-only reward ablation.

val_conditional_advantage.policy_v3.2: Conditional pairwise accuracy minus genome-only ablation pairwise accuracy; not downstream fit win rate.

val_top1_historical_regret.policy_v3.2: Mean over datasets of best retained target value minus value of highest predicted-reward retained candidate; not regret to an unknown optimal algorithm.

val_reward_cv_correlation.policy_v3.2: Pearson correlation between predicted rewards and retained robust_delta labels, despite CV in name; not downstream cross-validation score.

val_uncertainty_error_spearman.policy_v3.2: Pearson on positional sorted ranks of ensemble standard deviation and absolute reward error; ties do not use average ranks; implementation diagnostic rather than calibrated uncertainty.

val_head_accuracy_featmath.policy_v3.2: Fraction of featmath validation rows matching the first head-role grammar token under teacher-forced decoding; not valid fitted algorithm accuracy.

train_loss.policy_v3.2: Across-rank sum of per-batch composite losses divided by executed steps; includes learned uncertainty weights for sequence/runtime/stability and fixed-scale ranking/routing terms.

overfit_gap.policy_v3.2: val_loss minus train_loss; same logged combination but different example populations and phase weighting.

historical_source_binding_limit: The retained legacy source declares policy_v3.2 and agrees with log field construction. Gen31 log does not embed a source SHA, so these definitions are source-based reconstruction, not an exact-run build attestation.
